translations.en: Aḥmad b. Mihrān, al-Kulaynī narrated from him in the book "Al-Kāfī".

en.summary: Aḥmad b. Mihrān is a narrator cited by al-Kulaynī in his seminal work Al-Kāfī, where his reliability is assessed within the rigorous framework of Shia hadith sciences. Classified as weak (ḍaʿīf) by al-Ghada'iri, this designation highlights the critical scrutiny applied to transmitters to ensure the authenticity of prophetic traditions, reflecting the scholarly emphasis on verifying chains of narration (isnād) to preserve doctrinal integrity.
en.seo_question: Who is Aḥmad b. Mihrān and what is his status in Shia hadith literature?

key_terms.ضَعِيف: Weak, a classification of narrator reliability
